India prepares to present evidence against Pakistan at FATF

India is reportedly preparing to present evidence to the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) to have Pakistan placed on the grey list. This move comes amid allegations that terrorists are openly operating in Pakistan. The FATF's decision could have significant implications for Pakistan's financial standing.
